name: Passage! ~Passage of Life~
source:
Yuuya grew up on the Myoujin shopping arcade alongside his four childhood friends, Nana, Risa, Mio and Ayako. One day, he joined the graduation album production committee. He felt growing uneasiness as the preparations made him think of his future. What dream does he wish to pursue? What will happen to his unchanging days with his osananajimis? He wasn’t the only one who fretted about this.

The future is still a long ways away. They look to make memories at the school festivals and other events during the last year before their graduation. Along the way, their relationship begins to change: from childhood friends to lovers. This is their own special story for something that could happen to anyone in any place.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Yuuya和他的四个儿时好友Nana、Risa、Mio和Ayako一起在明神购物中心长大。有一天，他加入了毕业相册制作委员会。当这些准备工作让他想到自己的未来时，他感到越来越不安。他想要追求什么梦想？和他的奥萨纳纳吉米斯一成不变的日子会发生什么呢？他并不是唯一一个为此烦恼的人。

未来还很遥远。他们希望在毕业前最后一年的学园祭和其他活动中留下美好回忆。一路走来，他们的关系开始发生变化：从青梅竹马变成了恋人。这是他们自己的特殊故事，讲述了可能发生在任何地方任何人身上的事情。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
